title: ForgeResponse
description: AI Forge: the learner describes a game object in words, the model builds it from a few primitive shapes. The server validates every reply against this file and server/forge_validate.py before the page sees it. Numbers are range-checked in code, because the schema checker does not support minimum/maximum.

name.description: snake_case ASCII id used in code: spawn("name", x, z). Letters, digits, underscore, starts with a letter. The server makes it unique.

label.description: Display name in the learner's language.

parts.description: Primitive shapes, y is up, the object rests on y = 0.

position.description: [x, y, z] centre of the part. x, z in -3..3, y in 0..6.

size.description: [width, height, depth] of the part, each 0.05..4. For round shapes width and depth are diameters.

explanation.description: What was built and how to place it, in the learner's language.

model.description: Model id that produced the reply, set by the server.
